summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Studio Market 41. Backend: 19/19 pytest passing (settings, quote, availability, bookings incl. double-booking 409, past-date/agreements/combo validation, payments/checkout returning stripe.com URL, JWT auth 401 protection, admin CRUD for settings/block-date/block-slot/stall-unavailable/reservations/cancel). Frontend: Home renders, admin login+dashboard tabs render+save toast works. Booking wizard reaches Stripe checkout SUCCESSFULLY for the DAILY rental path (total=$70 correct, redirected to checkout.stripe.com). HOURLY path is BLOCKED by a logic bug in clickHour that prevents selecting >=4 consecutive hours.

ui_bugs.issue: Cannot select a range >= 4 hours in hourly rental. After the first slot click, both startHour and endHour are set (start=h, end=h+1). The very next click hits condition `(startHour !== null && endHour !== null)` and RESETS to a new 1-hour window instead of extending. As a result the user can never reach the 4-hour minimum, `canNext` on step 2 never becomes true, and the entire hourly pay flow is unreachable. Fix: change the reset condition to only reset when `startHour === null` OR when clicking a slot at/inside the current selection; when startHour is set and endHour > startHour, treat h > startHour as extension via rangeAvailable(startHour, h+1).

action_items: Fix Booking.js clickHour so that the second click on a later slot extends the range (setEndHour(h+1)) instead of resetting when endHour is already set. Suggested logic: if startHour !== null && h > startHour && rangeAvailable(startHour, h+1) → setEndHour(h+1); reset only when h <= startHour or startHour === null.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking.js: clickHour range-extension is unreachable due to the reset branch firing whenever endHour is non-null (which it is after the very first click). This is the primary blocker.
server.py OK: proper 401/409/400, no _id leaks (find_one uses projections), settings idempotent, admin seed re-hashes on password change.
Frontend admin dashboard save flows show a shared 'Saved' toast — acceptable but a per-tab success message would be clearer.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (hourly booking path broken; daily+admin work end-to-end incl. Stripe redirect)

seed_data_creation: Created ~6 pending TEST_ bookings on 2026-11-17/18/20 and 2027-02-10 during testing; test_zz_cleanup cancels the ones tracked in-memory. Some UI-created bookings on 2027-02-10 (stall A daily) will remain pending until manually cancelled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green via /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py. Focus retest on the hourly slot-selection fix: click stall A → hourly → future weekday date → click slot-8 then slot-12 and verify Selected shows 8AM-12PM (4h), review-total shows $40, and pay-btn enables + redirects to stripe.com. Daily and admin flows already verified working.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Booking.js clickHour(): the branch `if (startHour === null || (startHour !== null && endHour !== null)) { setStartHour(h); setEndHour(h+1); return; }` short-circuits every click after the first. Because the initial click sets endHour=startHour+1, endHour is never null again, so the extend branch below (which checks rangeAvailable(startHour, h+1) and setEndHour) is dead code. Reproduction: /book → count-1 → stall-A → next → rental-hourly → next → date 2027-01-15 → click slot-9 (shows 9-10 selected) → click slot-13 → observe selection collapses to 1-2PM (1h) with error 'Minimum booking is 4 consecutive hours.'. Mitigation: rewrite condition so that when startHour is set and h > startHour and rangeAvailable(startHour, h+1) → only setEndHour(h+1); when h < startHour → reset with new start; when h === startHour → optionally deselect.
